title.purpose: Panel and section heads, led by the red square marker.

figure.purpose: Stat-line values, RP, money totals; tabular lining numerals.

score.purpose: Score inputs in the match steppers.

table-head.purpose: Table header rows, text-soft on stage.

shadows.name: red-glow
shadows.purpose: Section marker, progress fill, active tab bar, next-up VS; 18px on the match VS disc.

shadows.name: winner-tag
shadows.purpose: ชนะ tag and brand mark (blue tag uses rgba(91,140,255,.4)).

shadows.name: medal-glow
shadows.purpose: Rank-1 disc; แชมป์ stamp uses 0 0 12px at .4.

shadows.purpose: Input focus halo with hot-red border.

motion.name: motion-press
motion.purpose: Press-down duration for buttons, tiles and tabs.

motion.name: motion-fast
motion.purpose: Transform and opacity transitions on controls.

motion.name: motion-base
motion.purpose: Colour, border and shadow transitions; overlay fades.

motion.name: motion-slow
motion.purpose: Masthead morph between pages; sheet entrance.

motion.name: motion-exit
motion.purpose: Quick departure for exits and toasts leaving.

motion.name: stamp-strike
motion.purpose: ชนะ tag drops from 1.9x to rest at its ∓4deg tilt; card jolts 2px; result line inks in. Only on a live result change.

motion.name: dock-crossfade
motion.purpose: Tab dock stays put; active tab crossfades.

motion.name: digit-tick
motion.purpose: Score digits drop 4px into place on change.

motion.name: loser-fade
motion.purpose: Loser name fades to 42% when a match is decided.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No travel, no strike; skeleton sweep and toast timer stop.

narrative.northStar: Match Night Under the Red Light
narrative.overview:
The league reads as a dark esports-style sports app on match night. The ground is a near-black arena (bg) lit by one red spotlight: a soft red radial bloom in the top-right corner of the page and a fainter one on the left. Content sits on smoked-glass panels (panel with a faint white sheen across the top 120px, a hairline white border, 14px corners, a deep soft shadow). Red is the only loud colour; it carries the primary action, the active tab, section markers, the VS disc and the winner's tag, and it glows. Every pairing is still a face-off, red corner left and blue corner right, with a glowing VS disc between.

Density is phone-first and operational. Big sporty words (the league name, page titles, scores, figures, stamps) are set in Kanit 800 italic; names and section titles in Kanit 600 upright; everything you read or operate stays in Anuphan. Desktop widens the league home into two columns (matches on the left, sticky standings on the right) without changing the vocabulary. This world replaces the yellow fight-poster world (Chonburi, magenta masthead, paper panels on poster yellow) that the site had before.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black arena ground with a red radial bloom; smoked-glass panels with hairline white borders and 14px corners.
Two Kanit cuts only: 800 italic for the big sporty words and numbers, 600 upright for names and section titles; Anuphan for everything else.
Red is the one accent and the interaction colour (primary button, focus, caret, selection, active tab, progress); it glows.
Red corner / blue corner for every match-up; green and coral-red only for won/lost money and W/L.
Gold, silver and bronze for ranks 1-3, the leader row and champions.
Lifted surfaces: panels, the masthead, the tab dock and sheets cast deep, soft black shadows; red elements add a red glow.

rules.name: The One Light Rule
rules.body: Red is the only accent colour in the arena. Gold, silver and bronze mean rank; green and coral mean won and lost; blue means the right corner. Nothing else gets a hue.

rules.name: The Two Corners Rule
rules.body: Any head-to-head pairing is red on the left, blue on the right, every time. Red/blue never encode good/bad.

rules.name: The Money Is Green and Coral Rule
rules.body: Win green and lose coral are reserved for won/lost amounts, W/L results and rank movement.

rules.name: The Two Cuts Rule
rules.body: Kanit exists on the site only as 600 upright and 800 italic. Italic means loud (titles in the masthead, numbers, stamps); upright 600 means names and section titles. Never ask for another weight or an upright 800; `font-synthesis:none` means the browser will not fake one.

rules.name: The Arena Voice Rule
rules.body: Kanit is for what the scoreboard would show: titles, names, scores, money, stamps. Controls, labels and explanations stay in Anuphan.

rules.name: The Glow Means Red or Gold Rule
rules.body: Coloured light comes only from red (action, live, winner) and gold (rank 1, champion). Everything else lifts with neutral black shadow or not at all.

rules.name: The Flat Inside Rule
rules.body: Only top-level things lift: panels, masthead, dock, sheets, toasts, the primary button. Rows and controls inside a panel stay flat on tone and hairlines.

dos: Do put every page on the arena-black ground with the red bloom, and every content block on a smoked-glass panel with a 1px line border, 14px corners and the panel shadow.
Do bill every pairing red corner left, blue corner right, with the glowing VS disc between.
Do set the loud words (masthead titles, scores, figures, money, stamps) in Kanit 800 italic and names and section titles in Kanit 600 upright; keep controls and labels in Anuphan.
Do mark a winner with the tilted ชนะ tag in their corner colour, and fade the loser, rather than adding an icon.
Do flatten lists inside a panel into rows divided by line hairlines.
Do use drawn SVG icons (24px grid, 1.8 stroke, round caps) where an icon is needed.
Do keep red as the single accent, with hot red for focus, caret, selection, the active tab and red text on dark.
Do keep numbers in tabular lining figures.
donts: Don't bring back the yellow fight-poster world: poster-yellow ground, paper panels, 2px ink rules, the magenta masthead or Chonburi.
Don't add a second accent hue; blue belongs to the right corner, gold/silver/bronze to rank, green and coral to won/lost.
Don't use red or blue corner colours to mean good or bad; won/lost is green and coral.
Don't request Kanit weights or styles other than 600 upright and 800 italic.
Don't put shadows or glow on rows, inputs or tags inside a panel; only top-level surfaces lift, and only red and gold glow.
Don't use emoji or text glyphs as icons.
Don't nest boxed cards inside panels, or lay stats out as a wall of big-number tiles.
Don't print an empty stat as a headline-size dash; drop it.
